complete_examples.text: The ballasted track structure is one of the most common track types for the heavy-haul railway due to its good elasticity, low price and easy maintenance, which mainly includes the rail, sleeper and ballast [2].

In order to ensure the stability of train operation and the safety of the track–bridge subsystem, it is necessary to accurately grasp the dynamic performance of the heavy-haul train-ballasted track–bridge system and evaluate the status of the system under multiple random conditions.
